input.rationale: check_spending_cap returned ok:false for the $240 diaper order. I passed 240 as amountUsd, which is a conservative figure because the draft is in CAD. I used "supplies" as the category, which was my own guess. Idempotency and user-override checks both passed (ok:true), so the order is not a duplicate and no override applies. A red spending-cap result is a clear policy violation, so I am rejecting.
input.remediation: Reduce the order to fit under the family's spending cap, for example 1 box instead of 2. Or get the parent's explicit approval for the over-cap amount. Then resubmit with a new action_hash. The spending-cap check also needs an explicit USD amount and a category, so include both in the draft. Also confirm the category the cap uses, since "supplies" was my guess.
